sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Pink Rain Drop Glass Bangles (12 Piece)
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Description:
Make a bold statement with this radiant set of Pink glass bangles, beautifully adorned with shimmering golden bead accents. Crafted from premium glass, each bangle showcases a vibrant red hue, symbolizing joy and tradition—perfect for weddings, festivals, parties, and everyday ethnic wear.
Handcrafted for durability and lightweight comfort, these bangles add a dazzling touch to sarees, lehengas, salwar suits, and indo-western outfits. The golden bead detailing brings subtle sparkle, making this set a stunning accessory for bridal jewelry, festive looks, or thoughtful gifting.
Key Features:
- Premium red glass bangles with intricate golden bead embellishments
- Handcrafted for a flawless, elegant look
- Lightweight and comfortable for extended daily or festive wear
- Ideal for weddings, festivals, parties, and gifting
- Complements both traditional and modern Indian attire
